steps.sql:
with src as (
 select upper(trim(a.account_code)) acc, upper(trim(a.depreciation_account_code)) dacc, upper(trim(a.depreciation_sum_account_code)) sacc,
  round(d.as_buy_price, 2) buy, case when coalesce(d.as_dead_value, 0) <= 0 then 1.00 else round(d.as_dead_value, 2) end dead, d.as_age::int age,
  coalesce(nullif(round(d.insure_money, 2), 0), round(d.as_buy_price / 100, 2)) ins
 from as_asset a join as_asset_detail d on d.as_code = a.code
 where a.code not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(d.as_buy_price, 0) > 100 and coalesce(d.as_age, 0) >= 2 and d.as_age = trunc(d.as_age)
  and exists (select 1 from gl_chart_of_account c where c.code = upper(trim(a.account_code)))
  and exists (select 1 from gl_chart_of_account c where c.code = upper(trim(a.depreciation_account_code)))
  and exists (select 1 from gl_chart_of_account c where c.code = upper(trim(a.depreciation_sum_account_code)))
 order by a.code limit 1),
dt as (select date_trunc('year', (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'))::date bd),
v as (select src.*, dt.bd, (dt.bd + make_interval(years => src.age) - interval '1 day')::date sp, (dt.bd - 1) bad, (dt.bd + interval '1 year' - interval '1 day')::date ie,
  round((src.buy - src.dead) / src.age, 2) svb, round((src.buy - src.dead) / src.age / 12, 2) cut from src, dt)
select v.acc, v.dacc, v.sacc, v.buy::text buy, v.dead::text dead, v.age::text age, round(v.age, 2)::text ager, v.ins::text ins,
 v.svb::text svb, (v.buy - v.svb)::text vb, v.cut::text cut, (extract(year from v.bd)::int + 543)::text bey,
 round(100.0 / v.age, 2)::text r1, round((1 - power(v.dead / v.buy, 1.0 / v.age)) * 100, 2)::text r2,
 v.bd::text bd, to_char(v.bd, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from v.bd)::int + 543)::text bdth, v.sp::text sp, to_char(v.sp, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from v.sp)::int + 543)::text spth, to_char(v.bad, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from v.bad)::int + 543)::text badth, v.ie::text ie, to_char(v.ie, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from v.ie)::int + 543)::text ieth,
 u.code u, u.shown ud, ty.code ty, ty.shown tyd, sd.code sd, sd.shown sdd, sd2.code sd2, sd2.shown sd2d, dp.code dp, dp.shown dpd, lc.code lc, lc.shown lcd, us.code us, us.shown usd, br.code br, br.shown brd, pv.code pv, pv.shown pvd, ac.shown accd, da.shown daccd, sa.shown saccd
from v cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from ic_unit order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) u cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from as_asset_type order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) ty cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from erp_side_list order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) sd cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from erp_side_list order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 1 limit 1) sd2 cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from erp_department_list order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) dp cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from as_asset_location order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) lc cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from erp_user order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) us cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from erp_branch_list order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) br cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from erp_province order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) pv cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from gl_chart_of_account where code = v.acc) ac cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from gl_chart_of_account where code = v.dacc) da cross join lateral (select code, code || case when coalesce(name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || name_1 else '' end shown from gl_chart_of_account where code = v.sacc) sa
